item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-26
item.description:
Our open-source research community has seen exciting developments recently. In the scienceverse/metacheck project, Lakens has made significant updates to the `data_check` branch, introducing a RO-crate metadata file and resolving regex bugs, which marks a notable shift in data handling. Meanwhile, the marton-balazs-kovacs/tenzing project has released version 0.4.1, with updates to the `gh-pages` and `master` branches, including a site build and a modification to the `sweet_alert.js` file. These advancements demonstrate the community's ongoing commitment to improving research tools and highlight the connections between projects, such as the use of standardized metadata formats like RO-crate. As our community continues to grow and collaborate, we celebrate these milestones and look forward to seeing the impact of these updates on our shared research endeavors. With these progress updates, we're eager to see how they will facilitate future innovations and discoveries.

item.title: metacheck: 1 commit today
item.description:
scienceverse/metacheck

The `data_check` branch was worked on, where a RO-crate metadata file was added, replacing the existing collection.json file. The full preview from the archive was removed as part of this change. Additionally, regex bugs were fixed, as stated in the commit message, which aimed to resolve specific issues with regular expressions. The changes were made by Lakens, who implemented these modifications on July 26, 2026. The removal of the full preview and the addition of the RO-crate metadata file suggest a shift in how data is handled and presented in the repository.

1 commit(s) today:
